reproduction_method: fetch the exact historical source commit object by SHA when it is not reachable from the current main lineage
create a detached isolated worktree at the exact source commit
execute the observer and source-bound rule pack from that exact worktree
run two clean observer builds and require identical topology SHA-256
require exact historical topology SHA-256 and exactly 569 WARNING members
sort members by anomaly_id and hash each complete canonical anomaly payload
derive one membership SHA-256 from the ordered payload-hash vector
fresh_census_method: execute the same exact historical observer independently at the pre-GRT2 materialisation baseline
never redefine B0 from the fresh census
retain raw current WARNING members and source-bound hashes as observation evidence
treat cross-tree anomaly_id intersection as diagnostic only because historical anomaly IDs are not v0.2 logical finding identities

defer B0 member mapping, late-discovered-pre-existing classification, resolved lineage and transition/new-debt classification to WP2 after BaselineMemberRecord, GRTFindingRecord and DebtLineageRecord contracts exist

forbidden_claims: raw anomaly-id equality proves logical finding continuity
raw anomaly-id difference proves resolution or new debt
WP0 current census proves transition debt is zero

gate_rule: GRT2-G1 BLOCK with B0_SOURCE_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE if source commit/tree/topology hash, 569 raw WARNING count, member uniqueness, or deterministic rebuild proof does not match exactly. Current-census lineage is not a G1 PASS condition and may not be inferred before WP2.
